# Upstream Implementations

This directory is reserved for local checkouts of official LLaDA, Fast-dLLM v1, ProcessBench, and evaluators. None have been downloaded yet.

Pin commits, record licenses and modifications, use separate environments, and save the versions actually executed in the configuration. A floating main branch is not a pinned experimental version. Fast-dLLM v2 must not replace the v1 backend specified in this plan.
